title: SwiftDrop event envelope (version 1)
description: Every message on the swiftdrop.events exchange uses this envelope. The routing key is always eventType. data holds identifiers only, never email addresses, phone numbers or street addresses.

eventId.description: UUID v4. Consumers use it to ignore duplicates (idempotent consumer).

eventType.description: <entity>.<what happened> in past tense, e.g. merchant.approved or parcel.status.out_for_delivery. Also the routing key.

version.description: Schema version of data. Fields may be added within a version; renaming or removing a field needs a new version.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant of the change. Consumers use it to ignore out-of-order updates.

producer.description: Service that owns the event, e.g. parcel-service.

correlationId.description: Copied from X-Correlation-Id (or from the event that caused this one) so one action can be followed through all logs.

aggregateId.description: Id of the entity the event is about (parcel, merchant, receipt, delivery).
